comment: Cross-implementation anchor for dimensionContext (kernel/src/dimension-context.ts). The rules a second implementation must reproduce, written so it can be coded from this file without reading the TypeScript: (1) planned entries keep the caller's order; status is `verified` iff recorded[id].decisions >= 1, else `unverified`, and an absent id is the same as a recorded zero — `{decisions: 0}`. (2) A recorded id absent from the plan becomes one `unplanned` entry, sorted by id ascending in UTF-16 code unit order. (3) totals.decisions sums planned and unplanned alike, each decision counted once; verified + unverified === planned always. (4) A duplicate planned id throws KERNEL_E_DIMENSION_DUPLICATE rather than collapsing. The ids here are the nine the iterate config owns (config/config.schema.json $defs.dimension.enum); the kernel validates their *shape* and never enumerates them, which is why this fixture may name them without the kernel knowing they exist.
expectedLine: 7/9 dimensions verified, 2 unverified (performance, spec-compliance), 1 unplanned (concurrency), 20 decisions
